solar_configuration.note: No geographic location or true north is asserted for the building. Optional observer coordinates enable Astral; otherwise this explicit artistic trajectory is used.

solar_fallback: explicit design-reference trajectory until observer supplied

zone_aliases.sim:LOUNGE: front wing social lounge; not second cafe

transfer_proposal.status: proposal pending operator approval after Phase04; no final GLB or PlayCanvas implementation
transfer_proposal.solar: Same hour/observer/orientation parameters; interpolate sky, exposure and sun; no sensor events from clock
transfer_proposal.lights: Area lights in Blender require tested punctual-light equivalents in PlayCanvas; individual mutable emitters remain separate. Compare against approved references before accepting any visual loss.
transfer_proposal.baking: Never bake mutable artificial illumination into an immutable room lightmap. Any environment/probe variants must exclude switchable light contribution.

emitter_radiance_policy: Per-role camera-visible radiance and daylight minimum in archviz-lighting.json. Independent of nominal Blender watts. Sources and emitters both reach zero on OFF.

lighting_design.reference: 1290 lounge: warm wall/ceiling coves and indirect corner lighting; 1288 office: warm pendants and glass reflections; 1286 reception: concealed wall wash and toe lighting
lighting_design.note: Design palette and nominal CCT, not measured spectra. Daylight remains separate. All sources and visible emitters switch/dim together; no artificial illumination baked into surfaces.

glazing_design.reflection: Fresnel reflection of actual modeled fixtures/furniture and generic CC0 environment; transparency preserved
